title: Prescriptions Terms: Handover Days on Replacements by Delivery Plan
content:
A lost-or-stolen replacement of a Kestrel Prescriptions record carries the theft replacement handover buffer according to the patient's delivery plan under Delivery & Pickup Services.

## Terms

| Patient's delivery plan | Days added |
|---|---|
| an active plan whose carrier may deliver controlled substances | 2, for the signed handover |
| an active plan whose carrier may not deliver controlled substances | 1, for collection at the store |
| no active delivery plan | nothing |

Whether the carrier may deliver controlled substances is read from the patient's active delivery plan. These days are added to the lost days remaining after any restraint, before the days covered by a corrected remake are taken off; the theft replacement days supply is never below zero and is taken down to whole days.

## Readings (hypothetical)

- An active delivery plan whose carrier may deliver controlled substances: 2 days added.
- An active delivery plan whose carrier may not: 1 day added.
- A cancelled delivery plan and no other: nothing added.
